name: in.straitlink/mcp
title: Strait
description: Create, search and pause deep links; QR codes; analytics, taps, events; domains; webhooks.

environmentVariables.name: STRAIT_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Strait secret key (st_live_...) from Dashboard > Settings > Secret keys. Optional: without it only check_app_links, search_docs and demo trace_tap work.

environmentVariables.name: STRAIT_DOCS_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to make search_docs use only the docs bundled with this version (no fetch of the live docs from straitlink.in).

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer and a Strait secret key: "Bearer st_live_..." from Dashboard > Settings > Secret keys (a Read only key is enough for reading).
